intro.title: Imperial Golden Yellow Topaz Stone
intro.descriptionHtml: Yellow Topaz is one of the most popular semi-precious stones. It has crossed borders and civilizations and is a stone with rich history and heritage. Yellow Topaz has great religious significance too, it is mentioned in the Bible. In ancient Egypt, yellow topaz was said to be the creation of Ra, the Sun God.

tabs.tab2_heading: Who should wear the Yellow Topaz gemstone?
tabs.tab1_description:
Imperial Yellow Topaz gemstone is one of the most remarkable gemstones. Topaz is a Sanskrit term, which represents ‘fire.’ The color of the gemstone is yellow. The symbolism represented by the sparkling golden gem fascinates the topaz lovers, both as a beautiful jewel and for its healing benefits. The imperial yellow topaz has the virtue of recharging vital energy of its holder. It provides a sense of self-confidence and attracts reliable people. It combats fatigue, depression, and emotional and psychological shocks. In Vedic Astrology, the Yellow Topaz stone is associated with Planet Jupiter or Guru Graha. Thus it blesses the wearer with wisdom, knowledge, intellect and success.

Imperial yellow topaz influences a person's life by bringing about positive changes to it. This is a lucky stone which brings kismet into your life and makes everything work in your favor. It allows you to form bonds with people who are beneficial to you while keeping you away from those who are harmful to you. It enhances your confidence and strengthens your belief in yourself. It is associated with harmony, peace, prosperity and serenity.

Topaz is the name derived from the Sanskrit word tapas, it means ‘fire’. Topaz gemstone is an aluminum silicate of the nesosilicate mineral class. It may contain traces of chromium, iron, manganese or titanium, which will give it a specific color. On the Mohs scale, its hardness is 8, which makes Yellow Sapphire a robust stone. As for its density, it is between 3.53 to 3.56. Topaz is recognized as the stone of self-realization. It is an ally of Sadhaks in raising awareness of our inner strength. Yellow Topaz is also renowned for warding off disease and maintaining health, it is a protective stone widely used throughout the world.

This gemstone will aid you in achieving many of your life's milestones if you keep your intentions pure, as this is what matters the most. It will also help to increase your energy, which is why it also helps to reduce stress and anxiety. If you are experiencing difficulties with your psychological well-being, this stone is at your disposal. It will aid in the development of mental stability and personality equilibrium. This precious gem is also associated with intelligence, creativity, and wisdom. It will affect your academic performance and improve your creative abilities. Additionally, it will enhance your reasoning and analytical skills. Yellow Topaz will assist you in adjusting to a new environment if you have recently begun a new job or relocated. Additionally, it stabilizes your finances and prevents losses.

Yellow Topaz is not a substitute for Yellow Sapphire though it is often used as a substitute of yellow sapphire. Because of the similarity in appearance it is difficult to differentiate between the two gemstones. Both the gemstones are different types of gemstones, which carry the distinctive features with a few similarities, healing powers, and benefits to the wearers. Yellow sapphire is a precious stone and is composed of mineral corundum. Natural Yellow sapphire is not available as abundantly in nature as Yellow Topaz. Yellow topaz is a semi-precious stone, darker in hue than Yellow sapphire and much less expensive than Yellow sapphire because it is found much more abundantly across all continents.

It is important to note that yellow sapphire appears in light yellow and has a cosmic color of blue, which corresponds to the Vishhudha (Throat) chakra, whereas yellow topaz appears in brilliant dark yellow and has a cosmic color of yellow, which corresponds to the Manipura or Solar Plexus chakra.

tabs.tab2_description:
Yellow Topaz gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits; it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Yellow Topaz. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Throat or the Vishuddha Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for blessings of confidence, communication and expression.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses self-confidence, communication, clarity and growth. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Imperial Yellow Topaz is frequently associated with a strong will, a positive outlook when confronting life's challenges, happiness, and a willingness to stay on course until the end. Students, those beginning a new business or career, and those attempting to lose weight or quit bad habits such as drinking and smoking are common recipients of yellow topaz.

Important Details: 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Imperial Yellow Topaz gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Imperial Yellow Topaz gemstones.

 

Imperial Yellow Topaz Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

The finest Yellow Topaz originates in Russia and Brazil, but it is also mined in Mexico, Utah, Colorado, and Texas in the United States. It is thought to be formed during the final stages of the formation of igneous rocks deep within the Earth, under extreme pressure and temperature. Topaz is formed before Quartz in the Earth's mineral crystallization process. Additionally, its deposits are found in South Asia.

Observe their Color:

The best quality Yellow Topaz stones are bright yellow in color with hue that is evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.

Notice their Clarity:

Yellow Topaz gemstones have good transparency, the best are clear with no eye-visible scratches or inclusions.

Dealers deal in Topaz stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Examine their Inclusions:

Because yellow topaz is always faceted, it is eye-clean and free of visible inclusions.

See their Shape:

Although probably the most popular shape of yellow topaz tends to be polished in oval and pear shapes, it is actually polished into many different shapes.

Check the Carats:

For Imperial Yellow Topaz of gem quality, the raw Imperial Yellow Topaz is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Imperial Yellow Topaz weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Imperial Yellow Topaz is sold by weight, Imperial Yellow Topaz prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Imperial Yellow Topaz has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Imperial Yellow Topaz

Due to treatments the Imperial Yellow Topaz stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Imperial Yellow Topaz do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate:

It is recommended that you should purchase Imperial Yellow Topaz gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Imperial Yellow Topaz are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Imperial Yellow Topaz from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Imperial Yellow Topaz gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

How to Energize & Recharge Imperial Yellow Topaz Gemstone?

How to check if Imperial Yellow Topaz suits you?

Preferably, a powerful gemstone such as Imperial Yellow Topaz should only be worn after consultation with an RRCT specialist. Nevertheless, it will be appropriate if worn according to RRCT, and we will add bhasm and energize it for only positive effects.

You can also give yourself at least 72 hours after embracing an Imperial Yellow Topaz to determine whether or not you are experiencing any negative effects. If after 72 hours of embracing the Imperial Yellow Topaz stone you do not feel even the slightest effect, you are safe to use Imperial Yellow Topaz, as this shows it is safe and sure for you and it will not negatively affect you in any way.

If after a few days of wearing you feel completely energized, inspired, and normal instead of confused, drowsy and numb, Imperial Yellow Topaz is a good choice for you. You will soon receive a subtle indication that wealth and good fortune are abundant in your life. Imperial Yellow Topaz has been considered a gemstone of luck and prosperity for centuries.

How to know if Imperial Yellow Topaz is working?

Yellow Topaz embodies the pure sensation of material fulfillment and gratification. In addition, this gemstone is associated with self-assurance, sobriety, integrity, wit, dedication, generosity, and sincerity. Additionally, it offers a variety of health benefits. It can treat jaundice, chronic memory loss, insomnia, and liver problems. In addition, Yellow Topaz is beneficial for indigestion, fever, loss of appetite, and liver disorders.

Within 10 days of wearing, you should notice any of the above signs, indicating that your yellow topaz is working for you.

How long do the effects of Imperial Yellow Topaz last?

If cared for properly, an Imperial Yellow Topaz can be worn as jewelry for generations. You must wear it until your chakras are balanced. Typically, experts advise wearing gemstones for four years, after which they are no longer necessary.
tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Imperial Yellow Topaz gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Imperial Yellow Topaz is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

The best quality Yellow Topaz stones are bright yellow in color with hue that is evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.

Cut

Best quality Yellow Topaz stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Imperial Yellow Topaz of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Yellow Topaz stones are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Yellow Topaz rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Yellow Topaz gemstones have good transparency, the best are clear with no eye-visible scratches or inclusions.

Dealers deal in Topaz stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Imperial Yellow Topaz Gemstone Price

The price of Imperial Yellow Topaz gemstone depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color and clarity. It is important to avoid the gemstone to be treated.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Imperial Yellow Topaz has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Imperial Yellow Topaz stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Imperial Yellow Topaz gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 5,230 to INR 37,945 (USD 65 to USD 474).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Imperial Yellow Topaz?

The best way to check the authenticity of Imperial Yellow Topaz is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Imperial Yellow Topaz are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Imperial Yellow Topaz carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that an Imperial Yellow Topaz is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Imperial Yellow Topaz have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Imperial Yellow Topaz, but if you find flaws, then your Imperial Yellow Topaz is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Imperial Yellow Topaz are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Imperial Yellow Topaz. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Imperial Yellow Topaz, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Imperial Yellow Topaz from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Imperial Yellow Topaz. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Imperial Yellow Topaz. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Imperial Yellow Topaz Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

Consider regularly cleaning your yellow topaz if you use it for healing. Whether you are working on yourself or someone else, you ought to constantly cleanse the stone's energy after each session.

However, if you only occasionally use your crystal for healing, you will not need to clean it as frequently. You could schedule something to occur once a month, once a week, or even once a season if you want to do it frequently.

This rule applies whether you wear yellow topaz as jewelry or use it as a decorative accent. In these circumstances, the crystal's energy is not being actively directed toward healing work.
